title: Velo Bright Spearmint Slim Nicotine Pouches
description: Velo Slim Bright Spearmint Nicotine Pouches deliver the familiar sweetness of Spearmint combined with a crisp menthol lift, producing a flavour that tastes cool, fresh and balanced. The interplay of sweet mint and sharp menthol makes Bright Spearmint a refreshing option. Each can contains 20 slim pouches made from plant-based fibres, designed for a discreet and comfortable fit under the lip. Nicotine is released gradually without smoke, vapour or odour, offering a practical way to enjoy flavour and nicotine anywhere. Produced in Europe, Velo nicotine pouches are available in a wide range of strengths and flavour profiles. Bright Spearmint comes in two options: Mild 6mg for users seeking a lighter nicotine release, and Medium 8mg for those who prefer a more potent dose. Nicotine Ranges: Mellow - 4mg to 6mg this is best for new users. Original - 6mg to 11mg this is best for regular users. Intense - 8mg to 17mg this is suited for more experienced users How to Use: Place one pouch under your upper lip and leave it in place for 20–40 minutes while the flavour and nicotine release gradually. When finished, remove the pouch and dispose of it responsibly. Please Note: Do not chew, suck or swallow the pouches.
